“Use web.run to grab → load → boot the OS” lives in a BIOS-style config in the project files.

So the BIOS becomes: a tiny spec the OS (and I) always honor before doing anything else.
I’ll give you three things:

How the boot flow works conceptually

The BIOS file format (with remote web.run boot baked in)

A ready-to-use “Boot OS” prompt that follows that BIOS
